name: Carrot Salad With Fried Shallots, Pepitas, and Yogurt

ingredients.name: olive oil, plus 1 tablespoon for finishing
chopped fresh dill, mint, or parsley
Freshly ground black pepper to taste

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice the shallots. Shred the carrots on a box grater.
Set a fine-mesh strainer over a small metal bowl, and place a paper towel–lined small plate nearby.

In a small saucepan, add sliced shallots and 1/2 cup oil. Oil should almost cover the shallots. Heat over medium until oil begins bubbling then continue frying while stirring constantly until shallots are golden brown, 7 to 8 minutes. (Shallots can burn quickly—do not leave stovetop.) Strain shallots through the prepared fine-mesh strainer. Reserve oil and transfer fried shallots to the prepared paper towel–lined plate. Set aside to cool, about 20 minutes.

In a large bowl, toss to combine carrots, fresh herbs, dried oregano, vinegar, and salt. Once shallot oil has cooled, add 3 tablespoons to the carrot mixture. Mix to combine and season with salt and pepper to taste.

On a serving plate, place the yogurt or labneh in the center. Using the back of a spoon, spread it into an even layer across the plate. Top with carrot salad mixture. Top salad pepitas followed by fried shallots. Drizzle with remaining 1 tablespoon and serve immediately.

not_counted: Freshly ground black pepper to taste

schema_metadata.keywords: carrot salad, Carrot Salad With Fried Shallots, Pepitas, and Yogurt

description: This carrot salad pairs fresh herbs and crunchy fried shallots with creamy yogurt and roasted pepitas for a simple dish that's equally suited to weeknight dinners and casual entertaining.
notes:
Optional substitutions: apple cider vinegar → white balsamic vinegar; whole milk strained Greek-style yogurt → labneh

Make-ahead and storage: Fried shallots can be stored in an airtight container at room temperature for up to two months. Fried shallot oil can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to one month.
The salad is best enjoyed right away, but leftovers can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 3 days.
author: Sharon Brenner
